args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and FIN-212
requiring banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that half-cent
values round to the nearest even cent, matching both the spec and the
expectations in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixed the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` caused by `src/money.py` not implementing banker's rounding.

## Problem
`round_money()` in `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 (and the function's own docstring) require `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` — banker's rounding. The test suite asserts half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g., `2.665 -> 2.66`, not `2.67`), which fails under `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money()` so half-cent ties round to the nearest even cent, per FIN-212.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
